describes: packages/plugin/view-manager: panes over the open documents.

cases.name: pending-rename-preserves-split-and-tab-position
cases.covers: A thunk ticket is split before resolving; its real id replaces it in that pane and active slot without losing placement. Later split uses an explicit nonfocused from pane.

cases.name: selectors-before-start
cases.covers: The capability exists from createKernel(); with no panes the selectors are empty, getPane() and getPaneOfDocument() are null.

cases.name: first-open-makes-a-pane
cases.covers: The effect reconciles whenever the open order changes: the first open (while still loading) creates pane-1 and assigns the document to it; later opens land in the focused pane; getPane/getPaneOfDocument/listPanes read the current public view.

cases.name: closing-prunes
cases.covers: Closing a document drops it from its pane and picks a neighbour as active; closing every document leaves the empty pane.

cases.name: panes
cases.covers: createPane focuses the new pane and later opens land there; removePane refocuses; movePane reorders with clamping and ignores unknown ids; setFocused takes any id.

cases.name: tabs
cases.covers: addDocument/removeDocument/setActiveDocument/moveDocumentWithin/moveDocumentBetween apply current transitions; the model ignores the invalid ones.

cases.name: reordering-tabs-reconciles
cases.covers: documents.move changes the open order, so the effect reconciles (a no-op for pane contents); setActive alone does not.

cases.name: a-failed-open
cases.covers: A document whose open fails keeps its tab in the order (status error), so it stays assigned until it is closed.

cases.name: create-populated-and-split
cases.covers: createPane with documentIds creates the pane, then moves each document into it (out of the pane that held it); splitPane(documentId) is createPane with that one document, and inserts beside its from option.

cases.name: remove-pane-targets
cases.covers: removePane moves its documents to moveDocumentsTo when given, else to the focused pane when that is another one, else to the last remaining pane; a target that is the pane itself or unknown moves nothing, and removing the only pane drops its documents with it.

cases.name: events
cases.covers: Every write is diffed: onPaneCreated for each new pane in order, onPaneRemoved for each removed one, onFocusChanged when the focus changes, and onDocumentMoved for each document whose pane changed (a document opening moves from null, one closing to null). A throwing listener is reported and its siblings still fire; after unsubscribing nothing fires.
cases.reason: Pins the pane events each write fires, which the event callbacks record. Its committed state changes and callbacks are recorded.

cases.name: a-kernel-installs-the-shipping-plugin
cases.covers: The unmodified shipping workspace plugin installs successfully; its selectors are available before start.

cases.name: destroy
cases.covers: After destroy the effect is gone and the capability no longer resolves.
